blocks.en: Skills in EVE govern the abilities of your character. They determine which ships you can fly, what modules you can use, the effectiveness with which you can use those ships/modules, and much more. This is a guide to learning those in-game skills, explaining the mechanics that govern skill training, and making suggestions for training strategies.
blocks.zh: EVE 中的技能决定了你角色的能力。它们决定你能驾驶哪些舰船、能使用哪些装备、使用这些舰船/装备的效果，以及更多方面。本文是一份学习游戏内技能的指南，讲解技能训练的相关机制，并给出训练策略方面的建议。

blocks.en: Overview
blocks.zh: 概述

blocks.en: Skills are a significant part of what defines a character and what they can do. If you want to fly a ship, use modules on that ship, mine, trade, and so much more, you will need to have trained specific skills for that. Additionally, training skills improve your performance (your ships will fly faster, your guns will do more damage, you will pay lower taxes, and so on). Some skills affect multiple areas of the game, but most are specialized. This has two major effects:
blocks.zh: 技能在很大程度上定义了一个角色以及他能做什么。如果你想驾驶一艘船、使用船上的装备、采矿、交易，以及做更多其他事情，都需要训练相应的技能。此外，训练技能还能提升你的表现（你的船飞得更快、武器伤害更高、缴纳的税更少，等等）。有些技能会影响游戏的多个方面，但大多数技能是专精的。这带来两个主要影响：

en: It does not take too much time to become proficient in one area of the game (say, flying missile frigates), as a finite number of skills improve your performance in that particular area. This also means that young characters (who have not been playing for as long) can quickly "catch up" to older characters in specific areas of the game.

Conversely, it takes much more time to become proficient in many (or even all) areas of the game; training every skill in the game to the maximum level would take around two decades of continuous training. In other words, older characters will be proficient in more areas of the game when compared with younger characters.
zh: 在游戏的某一个领域（比如驾驶导弹护卫舰）变得熟练并不需要太多时间，因为提升该领域表现的技能数量有限。这也意味着年轻角色（玩游戏时间较短的）可以在游戏的特定领域迅速“追上”老角色。
反过来说，要在游戏的许多（甚至所有）领域都变得熟练，就需要多得多的时间；把游戏里每个技能都练到最高等级大约需要连续训练二十年。换句话说，与年轻角色相比，老角色会在游戏的更多领域达到熟练。

blocks.en: Fortunately, skills are cumulative, and once you have invested time (skill points) into a skill you will never lose them (unless you choose to extract them using a Skill Extractor). This means that you can continuously improve your character's proficiency in one or several areas of the game, depending on your goals. The unique skill system of EVE Online allows you to train skills in real time, even when logged off. You should always have a skill in training.
blocks.zh: 幸运的是，技能是累积的，一旦你在某个技能上投入了时间（技能点），就永远不会失去它们（除非你选择用技能提取器把它们提取出来）。这意味着你可以根据自己的目标，持续提升角色在一个或多个领域的熟练度。EVE Online 独特的技能系统让你按现实时间训练技能，即使下线也照样进行。你应该始终保持有技能在训练。

blocks.en: As of 1 March 2025 there were 494 different skills in EVE, with a total of 2,361x training time multiplier, and a total of 604,416,000 skill points. Every Omega clone character can potentially learn every skill, but it would take over 24 years of skill training even with 32 points at all attributes, or 3,718 Large Skill Injectors, to achieve.
blocks.zh: 截至 2025 年 3 月 1 日，EVE 中共有 494 个不同的技能，训练时间倍率合计 2,361x，技能点总计 604,416,000。每个 Omega 克隆角色理论上都能学会所有技能，但即使所有属性都是 32 点，也需要超过 24 年的技能训练，或者 3,718 个大型技能注入器才能实现。

blocks.en: Alpha clone characters are limited to 175 different skills, with extra restrictions on the levels they can train, for a total of 19,669,072 skill points. Additionally, Alpha clone characters will have their training queue disabled once their trained skills plus their unallocated skill points reached 5,000,000 skill points; they cannot unpause it to train more skills, but still can apply unallocated skill points to skills. Alpha clone characters are also able to use a Daily Alpha Injector that gives 50,000 skill points.
blocks.zh: Alpha 克隆角色只能使用 175 个不同的技能，且可训练的等级还有额外限制，技能点总计 19,669,072。此外，一旦 Alpha 克隆角色已训练的技能加上未分配技能点达到 5,000,000 技能点，其训练队列就会被停用；无法取消暂停来训练更多技能，但仍然可以把未分配技能点用到技能上。Alpha 克隆角色还可以使用每日阿尔法注入器，获得 50,000 技能点。

blocks.en: Skills can be divided into the following groups:
blocks.zh: 技能可以分为以下几组：

en: Skills to create and manage player-run corporations
Skills to use and improve any drones that you use
Skills to improve your ship's CPU, powergrid, capacitor, and to perform capacitor warfare
Skills to form fleets with other players, and to make Command Bursts more powerful
Skills to use and improve turret-based weapons
Skills to use and improve missile-based weapons
Skills to make your ship faster and more agile, and to use propulsion modules
Skills related to using implants, jump clones and medical boosters
Skills needed to manufacture modules, ships, and more
Skills needed to mine raw materials, refine them, and salvage components from destroyed ships
Skills to make rigs fit to your ship more effective, and needed to manufacture rigs
Skills needed to find objects in space using scan probes, and to hack into secure containers in exploration sites
Skills related to the creation, storage, and sale of player-made ship skins
Skills to improve your standings with NPCs and to improve the rewards from running missions
Skills required to fly certain all classes of ship
Skills required to anchor and control various deployable structures, such as Upwell structures.
Skills required to use and improve the subsystems on Strategic Cruisers
Skills to lock more targets, faster, and at longer ranges
Skills to improve trading on the EVE market
zh: 创建和管理玩家军团的技能
使用和提升你所用无人机的技能
提升舰船CPU、能量栅格、电容，以及进行电容战的技能
与其他玩家组建舰队，以及让指挥脉冲波更强的技能
使用和提升炮台类武器的技能
使用和提升导弹类武器的技能
让舰船更快、更灵活，以及使用推进装备的技能
与使用植入体、跳跃克隆和医疗增效剂相关的技能
与行星开发相关的技能
制造装备、舰船等物品所需的技能
开采原材料、提炼原材料，以及从被摧毁的舰船上打捞部件所需的技能
让舰船上装配的改装件更有效，以及制造改装件所需的技能
使用扫描探针寻找太空中的物体，以及破解探索站点中的安全货柜所需的技能
与研究和发明相关的技能
与玩家自制舰船涂装的创作、存储和销售相关的技能
提升你与 NPC 的声望，以及提升任务奖励的技能
驾驶所有级别舰船所需的技能
锚定和控制各类可部署建筑（例如昇威建筑）所需的技能。
使用和提升战略巡洋舰子系统所需的技能
更快、更远地锁定更多目标的技能
提升在 EVE 市场上交易能力的技能

blocks.en: It would not be practical to go into detail describing all these skills on one page; there is therefore a separate page for each section of skills (linked above).
blocks.zh: 在一个页面里详细介绍所有这些技能并不现实，因此每一类技能都有单独的页面（见上方链接）。

blocks.en: Recommended skills
blocks.zh: 推荐技能

blocks.en: New pilots might want to consider some of the following lists of skills:
blocks.zh: 新飞行员可以参考以下几份技能列表：

en: The Short Skill Plan: a quick route into basic functionality in a wide range of effective Tech 1 frigate, destroyer, and cruiser hulls

EVE University does not require any particular skill training pattern from its members, but the Short Skill Plan is designed in part to make a character ready to participate usefully in many types of University fleet
Basic Skills: easily-accessible skills which can be quickly trained to medium levels
Support Skills: not necessarily required for specific ships/equipment, but very helpful
Fitting skills: make it easier to fit everything you need onto any ship
zh: 简短技能计划：快速掌握多种实用 T1 护卫舰、驱逐舰和巡洋舰舰体基本功能的路线
EVE University 并不要求成员按特定方式训练技能，但简短技能计划的设计目的之一，就是让角色能够在多种 University 舰队中发挥作用
基础技能：容易获得、能很快练到中等等级的技能
辅助技能：不一定是特定舰船/装备的必需技能，但非常有帮助
装配技能：让你更容易在任何舰船上装下所需的全部装备

blocks.en: Be aware too of "The Magic 14", 14 skills which benefit any ship you fly. These are not a skill plan, but they are skills worth training to medium levels in the medium term, and to level V in the long term.
blocks.zh: 另外也要了解“魔法 14 技能（The Magic 14）”，即对你驾驶的任何舰船都有好处的 14 个技能。它们不是一份技能计划，但值得在中期练到中等等级，长期练到 V 级。

blocks.en: Skillbooks
blocks.zh: 技能书

blocks.en: To learn a skill (unless it's part of your starting skills), a pilot must acquire and inject the relevant skillbook.
blocks.zh: 要学习一个技能（除非它属于你的初始技能），飞行员必须获得并注入相应的技能书。

blocks.en: Acquiring
blocks.zh: 获取

blocks.en: If you are a member of EVE University, the Skillbook Program will reimburse the cost of any skill which is NPC-seeded and costs no more than 3.5 million ISK.
blocks.zh: 如果你是 EVE University 的成员，技能书计划会报销任何由 NPC 出售、且价格不超过 350 万 ISK 的技能书费用。

blocks.en: Pilots who completed the starter missions from the career agents will have already been given some useful skillbooks. And more skills can be acquired by reaching goals on the AIR Career Program.
blocks.zh: 完成生涯代理人新手任务的飞行员已经获得了一些有用的技能书。通过达成 AIR 生涯计划中的目标，还可以获得更多技能。

blocks.en: The main way to acquire other new skillbooks is from the market. Pilots can browse the available skillbooks under 'Skills' in the Browse tab, or just search for a particular skill. Most skillbooks are sold by NPC corporations for a fixed price.
blocks.zh: 获取其他新技能书的主要途径是市场。飞行员可以在浏览标签页的“技能”分类下查看可购买的技能书，或者直接搜索某个技能。大多数技能书由 NPC 军团以固定价格出售。

blocks.en: The NPC sell orders can be distinguished in two ways: they have a uniform price, and they have nearly a year's worth of time listed in the 'Expires In' column. (The maximum amount of time a player can put a sell order up for, by contrast, is 90 days.)
blocks.zh: NPC 卖单可以通过两点来辨别：价格统一，并且“剩余时间”（Expires In）一栏显示将近一年。（相比之下，玩家挂卖单的最长时间是 90 天。）

blocks.en: Players also sometimes put up sell orders for NPC seeded skillbooks. If the order is priced below the NPC price, the player is probably selling off books they bought in error; if the order is above the NPC price, the player is probably hoping to trick someone into buying. It is good practice to check the NPC price before buying an NPC-seeded skill from a player sell order.
blocks.zh: 玩家有时也会挂出 NPC 出售的技能书的卖单。如果价格低于 NPC 价格，那么玩家很可能是在甩卖自己买错的书；如果价格高于 NPC 价格，那么玩家很可能是想骗人购买。从玩家卖单购买 NPC 出售的技能之前，先查一下 NPC 价格是个好习惯。

blocks.en: Some skillbooks are not directly injectable or seeded onto the market. Instead, they are acquired through the loyalty point stores of NPC corporations or from exploration sites. These tend to be more advanced skills, such as Precursor Frigate, which lets you pilot the Triglavian Damavik. Some players trade in these skills by finding them or buying them from LP stores where they have LP and then putting them up on the regular market for a profit. Depending on how hard it is to obtain these skills outside of the market, buying them from players selling them on the regular market can often be the simplest option.
blocks.zh: 有些技能书无法直接注入，也不在市场上由 NPC 出售。它们要通过 NPC 军团的忠诚点商店或探索站点获得。这些通常是较高级的技能，例如先驱者护卫舰操作，它能让你驾驶三神裔的达玛维克级。有些玩家会通过找到这些技能书，或在自己有 LP 的 LP 商店里兑换，再挂到普通市场上赚取利润。取决于在市场以外获得这些技能的难度，直接从普通市场上的玩家手里购买往往是最简单的选择。

blocks.en: Updates in 2019 opened up another way to acquire skillbooks. Any skillbook which is available via an NPC-seeded sell order can instead be purchased and immediately injected via the Character Sheet skill page. Injecting skills directly from the character skill interface can be done anywhere, and is thus a useful option for pilots living in wormholes and other logistically challenging places; to counterbalance this convenience, the price of taking this option is 30% higher than the standard NPC price, so pilots who can easily access NPC skill markets should continue to take that option if ISK is an issue.
blocks.zh: 2019 年的更新开放了另一种获取技能书的方式。任何有 NPC 卖单的技能书，都可以改为在人物表的技能页面直接购买并立即注入。从人物技能界面直接注入技能可以在任何地方进行，因此对于住在虫洞和其他后勤困难地区的飞行员来说是很有用的选择；为了平衡这种便利，这种方式的价格比标准 NPC 价格高 30%，所以能方便前往 NPC 技能市场的飞行员如果缺 ISK，还是应该继续走市场购买的路子。

blocks.en: Injecting
blocks.zh: 注入

blocks.en: Once you have acquired a skillbook, you can "inject" a skillbook.
blocks.zh: 获得技能书后，你就可以“注入”它。

blocks.en: Right-clicking on a skill in a hangar or cargohold, also gives you an 'Inject skill' option. Injecting a skill shunts the skill from the skillbook into the Skills list on your Character Sheet (and destroys the skillbook), but doesn't actually start training -- effectively it stores the skill at 'level 0'.
blocks.zh: 在机库或货柜舱中右键点击技能书，也会出现“注入技能”选项。注入技能会把技能从技能书转移到人物表的技能列表中（并销毁技能书），但不会真正开始训练——实际上相当于把技能存为“0 级”。

blocks.en: Injecting is useful if you have bought a skill that you have the intent to train, but do not actually want to start training it right away or have yet to meet the requirements to train: once it's injected, you do not need to worry about keeping the skillbook with you, and there's no risk that you will lose the skillbook if you fly into dangerous space and lose your ship. The same is true and useful for jump clones -- you can jump to a clone in hisec or a trade hub, acquire and inject the skill there, and then (after the jumpclone waiting period) jump back to your main clone somewhere in more dangerous space, where you can train the skill at your leisure. Note that you can inject a skillbook without knowing all the prerequisites to actually start training the skill.
blocks.zh: 如果你买了一个打算训练的技能，但暂时不想马上开始训练，或者还没满足训练要求，注入就很有用：一旦注入，你就不用担心随身携带技能书，也不会因为飞进危险空间丢船而丢掉技能书。这一点对跳跃克隆同样适用且有用——你可以跳到高安或贸易中心的克隆，在那里购买并注入技能，然后（等跳跃克隆冷却结束后）再跳回位于更危险空间的主克隆，在那里慢慢训练这个技能。注意，即使不具备开始训练该技能的全部前置条件，你也可以注入技能书。

blocks.en: Training skills
blocks.zh: 训练技能

blocks.en: You can train a skill by dragging and dropping it into the training queue, or by right-clicking on it in your Skills list. The first skill in your training queue is the one training at the moment, once fully trained the next one starts automatically training. Unallocated skill points (skill injectors, or AIR Daily Goals), can be applied to a skill in the training queue. Two options are possible :
blocks.zh: 你可以把技能拖放到训练队列中，或者在技能列表中右键点击它来训练。训练队列中的第一个技能就是当前正在训练的技能，练完后下一个会自动开始训练。未分配技能点（来自技能注入器或 AIR 每日目标）可以用到训练队列中的技能上。有两种方式：

en: To apply to a single skill, right click on a skill in the training queue and select "apply skill points".
To apply all your unallocated skill points to your training queue, click on the "+" button on the right side of the total training time.
zh: 要用到单个技能上，在训练队列中右键点击该技能并选择“应用技能点”（apply skill points）。
要把所有未分配技能点用到训练队列上，点击总训练时间右侧的“+”按钮。

blocks.en: Skill points can be applied to skills already partially trained or injected.
blocks.zh: 技能点可以用到已部分训练或已注入的技能上。

blocks.en: Unallocated skill points are included in the total skill points amount listed on the character sheet.
blocks.zh: 未分配技能点会计入人物表上显示的技能点总数。

blocks.en: Note: As of 23 July 2024 Omega clone subscribers can get 15,000 skillpoints for free weekly in the New Eden Store. The offer refreshes at downtime on Tuesday.
blocks.zh: 注意：自 2024 年 7 月 23 日起，Omega 克隆订阅者每周可以在新伊甸商店免费领取 15,000 技能点。该优惠在每周二的维护时刷新。

blocks.en: Training Time Multipliers
blocks.zh: 训练时间倍率

blocks.en: So, how is the time it takes you to train a particular skill calculated? The number of skill points necessary to train a skill is determined by the skill's rank, also known as its training time multiplier, while the rate at which you get new skill points is determined by your attributes.
blocks.zh: 那么，训练某个技能所需的时间是怎么算的呢？训练一个技能需要的技能点数由该技能的等级（rank）决定，也就是它的训练时间倍率；而你获得新技能点的速度由你的属性决定。

blocks.en: The base numbers of skill points (SP) required to train a skill with a training time multiplier of 1x (like Navigation, for example) go like this:
blocks.zh: 训练时间倍率为 1x 的技能（例如导航学）所需的基础技能点（SP）如下：

blocks.en: When training from one level to the next you start with the skill points you accumulated training the previous level - so, for example, if you start training Navigation IV, you will already have 8,000 SP in the skill and will need to train 37,255 more SP to move from III to IV.
blocks.zh: 从一个等级训练到下一个等级时，你会从上一等级累积的技能点开始——例如，如果你开始训练导航学 IV，该技能中已经有 8,000 SP，从 III 升到 IV 还需要再训练 37,255 SP。

blocks.en: If a skill has a training multiplier higher than 1, the number of SP required for each level is multiplied by that number. So, for example, Evasive Maneuvering has a training time multiplier of 2x, and you need to accumulate 500 SP (250 x 2) to train it to I, 2,828 SP to train it to II and so forth.
blocks.zh: 如果一个技能的训练倍率大于 1，每个等级所需的 SP 都要乘以这个倍率。例如，规避机动理论的训练时间倍率是 2x，练到 I 级需要累积 500 SP（250 x 2），练到 II 级需要 2,828 SP，依此类推。

blocks.en: The better the benefits of a skill or the equipment it lets you use, the higher its training time multiplier, or 'rank' as it's sometimes called, tends to be. Amarr Titan, for example, has a x16 training multiplier -- you need to accumulate 4,096,000 SP to train it to V.
blocks.zh: 一个技能本身或它允许使用的装备越强，它的训练时间倍率（有时也称为“等级（rank）”）往往就越高。例如，艾玛泰坦操作的训练倍率是 x16——练到 V 级需要累积 4,096,000 SP。

blocks.en: SP=250×multiplier×32(level−1)

This is a partial chart of level and rank to figure out how many skill points a full skill takes, in thousands of SP. Using this table, we can figure that a rank 10 skill would take 3.1 mil skill points from level 0. Note how the first four levels of a skill are 1/5th the amount of the maxed skill.
blocks.zh: 下面是按等级和倍率计算一个技能所需技能点的部分对照表，单位为千 SP。利用这张表可以算出，一个倍率 10 的技能从 0 级练满需要 310 万技能点。注意，一个技能前四级所需的技能点是满级的五分之一。

blocks.en: Attributes
blocks.zh: 属性

blocks.en: Every EVE character has five attributes. These are:
blocks.zh: 每个 EVE 角色都有五项属性，分别是：

blocks.en: These attributes determine how quickly you train the various skills in the game. They do not influence anything else about your character. Since time is perhaps your most valuable asset in EVE, understanding attributes and optimizing them for your character's plans is absolutely vital. In order to view your attributes, open your character sheet and select "Attributes". The five attributes for your character will be listed there.
blocks.zh: 这些属性决定你训练游戏中各种技能的速度，除此之外对角色的任何其他方面都没有影响。由于时间可能是你在 EVE 中最宝贵的资产，理解属性并根据角色的规划来优化属性是绝对必要的。要查看属性，打开人物表并选择“属性”（Attributes），你角色的五项属性就会列在那里。

blocks.en: By default, your character has a score of 20 in all attributes (except Charisma, with a score of 19).
blocks.zh: 默认情况下，角色的所有属性都是 20 点（魅力除外，为 19 点）。

blocks.en: Effects on skill training
blocks.zh: 对技能训练的影响

blocks.en: Every skill has a primary and a secondary attribute: Navigation, for example, lists Intelligence as its primary attribute and Perception as its secondary attribute. When you start training a skill, you can calculate the time needed (in minutes) thus:
blocks.zh: 每个技能都有一个主属性和一个副属性：例如导航学的主属性是智力，副属性是感知。开始训练一个技能时，可以这样计算所需时间（单位为分钟）：

blocks.en: t=SP needed−Current SPPrimary Attribute+(Secondary Attribute/2)
blocks.zh: t=（所需 SP−当前 SP）/（主属性+(副属性/2)）

blocks.en: In general, the skillpoints accumulate at a rate equal to
blocks.zh: 一般来说，技能点的累积速度等于

blocks.en: It's not necessary to know the mathematics involved here, but the important thing to note is that your score for a skill's primary attribute will affect its training time twice as much as your score for its secondary attribute. You can find your attribute scores on your character sheet under Character -> Attributes.
blocks.zh: 你不必掌握这里涉及的数学，但需要注意的重点是：技能主属性的分数对训练时间的影响是副属性的两倍。你可以在人物表的 角色 -> 属性 中查看自己的属性分数。

blocks.en: A default character (assuming it is an Omega clone) with no modification to their ability scores gains between 29 and 30 skill points per minute (1740 to 1800 SP per hour). If the character is an Alpha clone, they only gain half (15 points per minute) as many skill points. An Omega character with neural remap focused on specific skills and +5 implants (see details below) can have 32+26/2=45 skill points per minute, 2,700 SP/h, 64,800 SP/day, 1.944M SP/month (per 30 days). See the following table for a breakdown of major options:
blocks.zh: 一个没有调整过属性的默认角色（假设是 Omega 克隆）每分钟获得 29 到 30 技能点（每小时 1740 到 1800 SP）。如果是 Alpha 克隆，获得的技能点只有一半（每分钟 15 点）。一个针对特定技能做了神经重塑并装了 +5 植入体（详见下文）的 Omega 角色，每分钟可获得 32+26/2=45 技能点，即每小时 2,700 SP、每天 64,800 SP、每月 1.944M SP（按 30 天计）。主要方案的细分见下表：

blocks.en: If you want to know your exact Skillpoint rate, you can use this calculator.
blocks.zh: 如果你想知道自己确切的技能点获取速度，可以使用这个计算器。

blocks.en: Each attribute is associated with skills for particular spheres of activity. Generally, the groups of skills are associated with particular attributes as follows - with some exceptions:
blocks.zh: 每项属性都与特定活动领域的技能相关联。一般来说，各技能组与属性的对应关系如下（有少数例外）：

en: Charisma, Memory / Willpower, Charisma / Charisma, Willpower
zh: 智力，记忆 / 感知，毅力
智力，感知 / 智力，记忆
智力，记忆 / 魅力，毅力
智力，记忆 / 魅力，智力
记忆，智力 / 智力，记忆
记忆，智力 / 智力，记忆
智力，记忆 / 记忆，魅力
感知，毅力（初级）/ 毅力，感知（高级）
记忆，毅力 / 记忆，魅力
智力，记忆 / 感知，毅力
魅力，记忆 / 毅力，魅力 / 魅力，毅力

blocks.en: As a rough summary:
blocks.zh: 简单总结一下：

en: Perception and Willpower are very important for combat pilots since they help you train skills that let you use better ships and weapons, and use your ships and weapons better.
Memory and Intelligence are very important for industrialists, and still quite important for combat pilots (they are useful for drone skills, fitting skills and tanking skills).
Charisma is important for traders and mission-runners, and anyone who's training in Leadership skills.
zh: 感知和毅力对战斗飞行员非常重要，因为它们帮你训练那些让你能使用更好的舰船和武器、并把舰船和武器用得更好的技能。
记忆和智力对工业玩家非常重要，对战斗飞行员也相当重要（它们对无人机技能、装配技能和坦克技能有用）。
魅力对商人和任务玩家，以及任何训练领导类技能的人都很重要。

blocks.en: It should be obvious that raising your attribute scores, particularly for skill groups you intend to spend lots of time training, is a very good idea. Ways to do this are discussed later in this guide.
blocks.zh: 显然，提高属性分数——尤其是你打算花大量时间训练的技能组所对应的属性——是个非常好的主意。具体方法会在本指南后文讨论。

blocks.en: General training strategies
blocks.zh: 通用训练策略

blocks.en: EVEMon
blocks.zh: EVEMon

blocks.en: EVEMon is a third party software tool that allows you to make plans on your character's skill training (as well as monitor and plan many other things).
blocks.zh: EVEMon 是一款第三方软件工具，可以让你为角色的技能训练做规划（还能监控和规划许多其他事情）。

blocks.en: Planning ahead
blocks.zh: 提前规划

blocks.en: When you first start playing EVE, you may have little idea of what skills you will be needing next week, let alone next month. But after your first few weeks, you will start to form a picture in your mind of what sorts of things you want your character to be able to do, and consequently which skills you will need. The specific training strategies listed elsewhere in this guide work much better when used together with a long term strategy.
blocks.zh: 刚开始玩 EVE 时，你可能完全不知道下周需要什么技能，更别说下个月了。但过了最初几周后，你会在脑海中逐渐勾勒出想让角色做哪些事情，进而知道需要哪些技能。本指南其他部分列出的具体训练策略，与长期策略结合使用时效果会好得多。

blocks.en: How many levels?
blocks.zh: 练几级？

blocks.en: As you train higher and higher levels in a skill, you get less benefit for the time invested.
blocks.zh: 一个技能练得越高，投入的时间所换来的收益就越少。

blocks.en: Surgical Strike, for example, gives you a 3% bonus to all turret damage per level - very useful for anyone who uses turrets as their primary weapon system - and has a 4x training time multiplier. You can get your first 3% bonus in a trivially short amount of time: even with basic attribute scores, training Surgical Strike to Level I takes 40 minutes or so. However, with the same basic attribute scores training Surgical Strike from Level IV to V would take nearly 25 days -- and you would still only get 3% more turret damage for your trouble!
blocks.zh: 例如，外科手术打击理论每级提供 3% 的所有炮台伤害加成——对于以炮台为主要武器系统的人非常有用——训练时间倍率为 4x。第一个 3% 加成只需极短时间就能拿到：即使是基础属性，把外科手术打击理论练到 I 级也只要 40 分钟左右。但同样的基础属性，把它从 IV 级练到 V 级需要将近 25 天——而辛苦这么久，你也只多拿到 3% 的炮台伤害！

blocks.en: For a new character, it is therefore often most efficient to train a useful skill that has a high training multiplier to III or IV and then move on rather than taking it to V straight away. As a rule of thumb, if you use a skill at all it's probably worth training it to III, and if you use a skill regularly it's worth training it to IV.
blocks.zh: 因此，对于新角色来说，把一个训练倍率较高的有用技能练到 III 或 IV 级然后转练别的，往往比直接练到 V 级更有效率。经验法则是：只要会用到的技能，就值得练到 III 级；经常用到的技能，值得练到 IV 级。

blocks.en: When your character is older you may well reach a point where you have fewer things you want or need to train - at this point, it may be worth revisiting some skills you left at IV and taking them to V.
blocks.zh: 等你的角色变老之后，很可能会到达一个想练或需要练的东西变少的阶段——这时可能值得回头把一些停在 IV 级的技能练到 V 级。

blocks.en: There are, however, some skills which it's worth training to V quite early on in your capsuleer career. For combat pilots Navigation is one such because:
blocks.zh: 不过，有些技能值得在克隆飞行员生涯早期就练到 V 级。对战斗飞行员来说，导航学就是其中之一，因为：

en: it has a low training time multiplier (1x)
it affects a very fundamental aspect of the performance of all of your ships (speed)
zh: 它的训练时间倍率很低（1x）
它影响你所有舰船性能中非常基础的一项（速度）

blocks.en: There are a number of other skills with a similar combination of quick training times and significant, widespread bonuses which are well worth training to V quite early.
blocks.zh: 还有许多其他技能同样兼具训练快、加成显著且适用面广的特点，非常值得早早练到 V 级。

blocks.en: Another class of skill which you may find yourself training to V are the so-called 'blackmail' skills which are prerequisites for particularly desirable equipment. On the way to training to fly the Wolf, for example, you would need to train Minmatar Frigate V, Mechanics V and Power Grid Management V. Similarly, on the way to deploying Tech 2 Hobgoblin drones you would need to train Light Drone Operation V and Drones V.
blocks.zh: 另一类你可能会练到 V 级的技能是所谓的“勒索”技能，它们是某些特别抢手装备的前置技能。例如，在练习驾驶猎狼级的路上，你需要训练米玛塔尔护卫舰操作 V、机械学 V和能量栅格管理学 V。同样，在使用 T2 地精灵无人机的路上，你需要训练轻型无人机操控理论 V和无人机概论 V。

blocks.en: Some skills are worth training to V because of a combination of several of the above reasons. Drones V for example lets you use a full flight of five drones, which is useful on any ship with a drone bay of 25m3 or more - and it's a prerequisite for the excellent Tech 2 drones.
blocks.zh: 有些技能值得练到 V 级，是因为同时满足上述多个理由。例如无人机概论 V能让你放出满编的五架无人机，这对任何无人机舱容量在 25m3 或以上的舰船都有用——而且它还是优秀的 T2 无人机的前置技能。

blocks.en: Boosting your Attributes
blocks.zh: 提升属性

blocks.en: This section of this guide deals with strategies to help you train skills faster.
blocks.zh: 本指南的这一部分介绍帮助你更快训练技能的策略。

blocks.en: Effectively, all of the methods discussed below improve your training times by boosting your character's attributes. This boosting usually comes at a cost of something else; other attributes, money, or time.
blocks.zh: 实际上，下面讨论的所有方法都是通过提升角色属性来缩短训练时间。这种提升通常需要付出其他代价：其他属性、金钱或时间。

blocks.en: Implants
blocks.zh: 植入体

blocks.en: Another way to increase your character's attributes is by plugging implants into your head. The first five numbered slots on your character sheet's Augmentations window are for attribute enhancers, implants which each give a bonus (from +1 to +5) to one of your five attributes. Unfortunately, if your pod is destroyed all your implants in the clone piloting it are destroyed as well.
blocks.zh: 另一种提升角色属性的方法是往脑袋里插植入体。人物表“强化”（Augmentations）窗口中编号前五的槽位用于属性增强植入体，每个植入体为五项属性之一提供加成（+1 到 +5）。不幸的是，如果你的太空舱被摧毁，驾驶它的克隆身上的所有植入体也会一并被摧毁。

blocks.en: The +1/2/3 implants are relatively cheap and you only need to train Cybernetics I to use them, so it's worth investing in these as soon as you can as, even with the smaller bonuses, they reduce training time by a significant amount. Storyline missions sometimes offer an implant as a reward so if you are running missions you may find yourself collecting some implants. Members of EVE University can also take advantage of the Implant Program to buy significantly discounted +3 implants.
blocks.zh: +1/2/3 植入体相对便宜，只需训练控制论 I就能使用，所以值得尽早投资——即使加成较小，它们也能显著缩短训练时间。剧情任务有时会奖励植入体，所以如果你在跑任务，可能会攒下一些植入体。EVE University 的成员还可以利用植入体计划以大幅折扣购买 +3 植入体。

blocks.en: Do note that there are also slot 1-5 implants (sometimes known as Pirate Implants) that also provide other bonuses, in addition, to attribute increases. While these are usually more expensive, do check the markets carefully, as sometimes some "Low-Grade" ones, which are +2 to an attribute, are occasionally less expensive than the equivalent +2 implant ("Limited <type> - Beta"). See the list here.
blocks.zh: 请注意，还有一些 1-5 号槽位的植入体（有时称为海盗植入体），除了提升属性外还提供其他加成。虽然它们通常更贵，但还是要仔细看看市场，因为有时某些“低级”（Low-Grade）植入体（属性 +2）偶尔会比同等的 +2 植入体（“初级<类型>—加强版”）更便宜。参见这里的列表。

blocks.en: If you are podded any implants you are wearing will be destroyed - you can set up a jump clone with cheaper implants, or no implants at all, and jump into it when you want to PvP to lower the amount of ISK you're putting at risk.
blocks.zh: 如果你的太空舱被打爆，你身上的所有植入体都会被摧毁——你可以设置一个装着便宜植入体或根本不装植入体的跳跃克隆，想打 PvP 时跳进去，以减少面临风险的 ISK。

blocks.en: Since the more powerful +4 and +5 implants can be quite expensive, particularly for a newer pilot, one common trick is to arrange your skill plan so that you're only training skills that rely on the same two attributes, and then only plug in attribute enhancers for those two attributes. This way you only have to pay for two implants rather than four or five.
blocks.zh: 由于更强的 +4 和 +5 植入体可能相当昂贵，尤其对新飞行员来说，一个常见的技巧是安排技能计划，让自己只训练依赖同样两项属性的技能，然后只为这两项属性插上属性增强植入体。这样你只需买两个植入体，而不是四五个。

blocks.en: The advantage of implants is that they require minimal training time (Cybernetics only), giving you an immediate boost to training time which can quickly add up to months of time saved. The disadvantage is their cost, coupled with the fact that they are lost if your pod is killed.
blocks.zh: 植入体的优点是所需训练时间极少（只需控制论），能立即缩短训练时间，日积月累可以省下好几个月。缺点是价格昂贵，而且太空舱被打爆就会损失。

blocks.en: Neural remaps
blocks.zh: 神经重塑

blocks.en: Neural remapping does not let you boost your attributes overall, but it lets you take points away from one base attribute and add them to another. The remap interface can be accessed through the Attributes tab of your Character Sheet.
blocks.zh: 神经重塑不能让你提升属性总和，但可以把点数从一项基础属性挪到另一项上。重塑界面可以在人物表的“属性”标签页中打开。

blocks.en: There are a number of rules governing remapping:
blocks.zh: 神经重塑有以下几条规则：

en: You start with a "normal" remap. The normal remap takes a year to replenish after use.
You start with two 'bonus' remaps. Bonus remaps are gone forever after use, they will never replenish!
If you have both normal and bonus remaps available then the normal remap will be used first.
Once you have used your normal remap and bonus remaps you must wait for the yearly timer to expire to remap again, so plan carefully!
You start with 20 points for Intelligence, Perception, Willpower and Memory; You start with 19 points for Charisma.
An attribute's base score may not be raised above 27 or lowered below 17.
Your total base attribute points are 99, and 14 of them can be remapped.
Any points taken off one attribute must be added to another -- your remaining unmapped points must be 0 when you finish remapping.
zh: 你一开始有一次“常规”重塑机会。常规重塑使用后需要一年才能恢复。
你一开始还有两次“额外”重塑机会。额外重塑用掉就永远没有了，不会恢复！
如果同时有常规重塑和额外重塑可用，会优先使用常规重塑。
常规重塑和额外重塑都用完后，必须等待一年的计时结束才能再次重塑，所以要仔细规划！
智力、感知、毅力和记忆的初始点数为 20；魅力的初始点数为 19。
任何属性的基础分数都不能高于 27 或低于 17。
你的基础属性点总计 99 点，其中 14 点可以重新分配。
从一项属性中扣除的点数必须加到另一项上——完成重塑时，剩余未分配点数必须为 0。

blocks.en: The common strategy for remapping is to put together a long-term skill plan that majors on skills that use a particular two attributes, and then remap so that you denude all your other attribute scores and pump up those two attributes.
blocks.zh: 常见的重塑策略是制定一份以使用特定两项属性的技能为主的长期技能计划，然后通过重塑把其他属性压到最低，把这两项属性拉满。

blocks.en: If you create a long skill plan in EVEMon, you can use one of the options of its 'Attributes Optimizer' function (available via the Skill Planner) to calculate which arrangement of attributes would be best for the first year of your plan. However, if you're new to the game your future career plans are quite likely to change as you explore the game, so making a year long plan after a few weeks is not very realistic. Be frugal with your remaps for a little while until you get an idea of what you want to do.
blocks.zh: 如果你在 EVEMon 中制定了一份长期技能计划，可以使用其“属性优化器”（Attributes Optimizer）功能（在技能规划器中）的某个选项，计算出对计划第一年来说最佳的属性分配。不过，如果你刚接触这款游戏，随着对游戏的探索，你未来的职业规划很可能会改变，所以玩了几周就制定一份一年期的计划并不太现实。在弄清楚自己想做什么之前，先节省着用重塑机会。

blocks.en: Cerebral Accelerators
blocks.zh: 大脑加速器

blocks.en: Main article: Medical boosters#Cerebral Accelerators
blocks.zh: 主条目：医疗增效剂#大脑加速器

blocks.en: Cerebral accelerators are consumed like boosters and give temporary bonuses to all five of a character's attributes, speeding up their skill training time. These can be acquired through certain in-game events (like the Crimson Harvest) or by buying in the New Eden Store (NES). Accelerators acquired through in-game events can only be activated for a limited time (usually a little after the end of the in-game event), after which they will have no effect. Accelerators acquired through starter packs can only be used by characters younger than a certain age, limiting their use to brand-new characters. Accelerators bought in the NES are applied to the character when redeemed.
blocks.zh: 大脑加速器像增效剂一样使用后消耗，能暂时提升角色全部五项属性，从而加快技能训练。它们可以通过某些游戏内活动（例如血色收割）获得，或者在新伊甸商店（NES）购买。通过游戏内活动获得的加速器只能在有限时间内激活（通常是活动结束后不久），之后就不再有效。通过新手礼包获得的加速器只能由低于一定年龄的角色使用，基本只限全新角色。在 NES 购买的加速器在兑换时直接作用于角色。

zh: 基础型“光辉”大脑加速器
高级血袭者大脑加速器
延展型“光辉”大脑加速器

blocks.en: The duration of boosters is extended if you have trained the Biology skill, by 20% per level trained; if you train Biology to level V, the duration of a booster is therefore doubled. For example, with Biology V trained, a Blood Raider Cerebral Accelerator will last 48 hours instead of the 24 shown in the table above.
blocks.zh: 如果训练了生物学技能，增效剂的持续时间会延长，每级 20%；如果把生物学练到 V 级，增效剂的持续时间就会翻倍。例如，练了生物学 V 后，血袭者大脑加速器可以持续 48 小时，而不是上表中的 24 小时。

blocks.en: Further suggestions
blocks.zh: 更多建议

blocks.en: Appropriate remapping
blocks.zh: 合理重塑

blocks.en: Neural remapping is essential for mid- or long-term planning (compiling mid or long term skill plans can be made using external tools such as EVEMon) and can help you cut several days or weeks of the training time needed to finish such a plan. Please remember that a fresh character is given only two chances to remap and after you used both remap, the next remap will only be available after one year of playtime, so use them carefully.
blocks.zh: 神经重塑对于中长期规划至关重要（中长期技能计划可以借助 EVEMon 等外部工具制定），可以帮你把完成这类计划所需的训练时间缩短几天甚至几周。请记住，新角色只有两次重塑机会，两次都用完后，下一次重塑要等一年游戏时间之后才能使用，所以要谨慎使用。

blocks.en: As a note, new players are not recommended to use their second remap within their first weeks of playing, the reason for this is that most skill plans made by that time will change based on what you (will) know and learn during the time you spent playing EVE Online.
blocks.zh: 需要提醒的是，不建议新玩家在刚开始玩的几周内就用掉第二次重塑，原因是那时制定的大多数技能计划，随着你在玩 EVE Online 的过程中了解和学到更多东西，都会改变。

blocks.en: After you know what you are planning for, and can make at least a mid- or long-term plan for things you want to do in EVE (which would probably be a several months or a year skill plan), you can begin to calculate an appropriate remap for the plan, this can be done using the help of EVEMon's attribute optimizer or by common sense. You can try to experiment with changing the remaps on the EVEMon attribute simulator and see which skills are affected positively (trained quicker) and which skills will take longer to train using that remap, skills that took longer to train (because of a higher multiplier or if you are training these skills to higher levels) would be affected much more by appropriate remaps in the long term rather than skills in which can be trained quickly. Several things you need to know before you decide to remap your attributes (since later on, you will only have the chance to do this once a year):
blocks.zh: 当你清楚自己的规划目标，并且至少能为想在 EVE 中做的事制定一份中长期计划（大概是几个月到一年的技能计划）之后，就可以开始为该计划计算合适的重塑方案，可以借助 EVEMon 的属性优化器，也可以凭常识判断。你可以在 EVEMon 的属性模拟器中试着改变重塑方案，看看哪些技能受益（练得更快）、哪些技能在该方案下要练得更久。从长远来看，训练时间较长的技能（因为倍率更高，或者要练到更高等级）受合理重塑的影响要比能很快练完的技能大得多。在决定重塑属性之前（因为之后每年只有一次机会），你需要了解以下几点：

en: You know which attributes are important to any given skill categories (for example, Perception and Willpower are very important for combat pilots while Memory and Intelligence are very important for industrialists)
You know what the skills are for a given role or category (for example, Battlecruiser skill is a combat oriented skill in which perception and willpower are important)
You have at least a plan for what you will be doing in EVE for the next six months or a year and can plan it accordingly.
You know that remaps can only be done once a year and that it will affect your training time greatly.
You are sure that the plans you have made are suitable for what and how you want to play the game and it includes a majority of core skills needed to pilot the ships you want.
zh: 你知道各技能类别看重哪些属性（例如，感知和毅力对战斗飞行员非常重要，而记忆和智力对工业玩家非常重要）
你知道某个职能或类别对应哪些技能（例如，战列巡洋舰技能是看重感知和毅力的战斗类技能）
你至少对接下来半年或一年在 EVE 中要做的事有个计划，并能据此进行规划。
你知道重塑每年只能进行一次，而且它会极大地影响你的训练时间。
你确信自己制定的计划适合你想玩的内容和方式，并且涵盖了驾驶目标舰船所需的大部分核心技能。

blocks.en: New player strategies
blocks.zh: 新玩家策略

blocks.en: New players get 3 initial remaps to spend, one normal remap and 2 bonus remaps. This might sound like a lot, but that's still 4 months per remap, and that's assuming you do not want to keep a bonus remap for next year.
blocks.zh: 新玩家一开始有 3 次重塑机会：一次常规重塑和两次额外重塑。听起来好像很多，但平均下来每次重塑也只管 4 个月，这还是在你不打算留一次额外重塑到明年的前提下。

blocks.en: While making a skill plan in EVEMon and getting it to calculate your remaps for you sounds good in theory, a new player is still exploring the game and your interests will change as you discover new aspects. One strategy is to continue with the default remap which should be fine for a new player. Nonetheless, there are some fairly safe initial strategies to use.
blocks.zh: 在 EVEMon 中制定技能计划并让它为你计算重塑方案，理论上听起来不错，但新玩家仍在探索游戏，随着发现新的玩法，兴趣也会改变。一种策略是继续使用默认属性分配，这对新玩家来说应该没问题。不过，也有一些相当稳妥的初期策略可供使用。

blocks.en: At the beginning of the game, almost all players will need skills from:
blocks.zh: 游戏初期，几乎所有玩家都需要以下技能：

zh: 电子学、工程学和机械学（智力 / 记忆）
飞船操控学（感知 / 毅力）

blocks.en: Combat oriented pilots will also need:
blocks.zh: 偏战斗的飞行员还需要：

zh: 射击学和/或导弹（感知 / 毅力）

blocks.en: Miners and Industrialists will need:
blocks.zh: 矿工和工业玩家需要：

en: Resource Processing, Science and Production (Intelligence / Memory)
zh: 资源处理、科学和生产（智力 / 记忆）

blocks.en: Traders will need:
blocks.zh: 商人需要：

blocks.en: If you look at these skills you will see that two attributes crop up more than any others: Intelligence and Perception. Willpower and Memory are secondary attributes for several things (with the exception of Drones) and Charisma is not required for any major skill groups unless you are a trader. Note that Willpower is the primary attribute for several skills in the Spaceship Command tree, but only for advanced ship skills, which at this point you will be training rarely compared to the basic ship skills. As such, a good strategy is to keep your initial remap for a few weeks and train basic skills in all of the main skill groups you need, including Social and Trade. Unless you are going to be a hardcore trader (in which case stop reading here and consult a more detailed guide for traders), you should then spend a remap to place all of your attributes in Intelligence and Perception. More combat-oriented pilots should put a few more points into Perception and more industrial pilots should invest a little more in Intelligence. This remap should serve you well for most of your first year, at which point you should have seen enough of the game to reliably make your own long term skill plans.
blocks.zh: 看看这些技能你就会发现，有两项属性出现得比其他属性都多：智力和感知。毅力和记忆是多项技能的副属性（无人机除外），而除非你是商人，否则任何主要技能组都不需要魅力。注意，毅力是飞船操控学中若干技能的主属性，但只限高级舰船技能，而在这个阶段，你训练它们的频率远低于基础舰船技能。因此，一个不错的策略是保留初始属性几周，把你需要的所有主要技能组（包括社会学和贸易学）的基础技能练一练。除非你打算成为硬核商人（那样的话就别往下读了，去看更详细的商人指南），接下来就可以用一次重塑，把属性全部加到智力和感知上。偏战斗的飞行员可以多给感知加几点，偏工业的飞行员可以多给智力加一些。这次重塑应该能让你在第一年的大部分时间里受益，到那时你应该已经对游戏有足够的了解，可以可靠地制定自己的长期技能计划了。

blocks.en: Specialization
blocks.zh: 专精

blocks.en: While training lots of skills to level III will give you many bonuses and a lot of options in a short time, being mediocre at many things is fun, but not very efficient. You can only have one ship in space at a time, so while being able to fly a Retriever and a Hurricane is nice, you can not mine and do level 3 missions at the same time, meaning that whichever you are currently doing you are not using a lot of your skill points. On the other hand, if you had focused fully on mining or combat, you could be flying a Hulk or a Maelstrom instead and making a lot more ISK at your chosen activity (at the expense of not being able to do the other at all). This principle also applies within professions - having mediocre skills in a Drake and Hurricane is nice, but you can only fly one at a time. Variety is the spice of life, and being able to play several aspects of the game makes it much more fun, but be aware that when joining a non-training corporation, they will probably want you to have a "specialization" of some sort, be it EWAR, damage dealing in a particular ship, logistics, mining or manufacturing.
blocks.zh: 把大量技能练到 III 级能在短时间内给你带来许多加成和很多选择，但样样都会、样样稀松虽然好玩，效率却不高。你同一时间只能有一艘船在太空中，所以虽然既能开回旋者级又能开暴风级很不错，但你没法同时采矿和跑 3 级任务，这意味着无论你在做哪一项，都有大量技能点闲置。另一方面，如果你完全专注于采矿或战斗，你就可以开着霍克级或死亡漩涡级，在所选的活动中赚到多得多的 ISK（代价是完全无法做另一项）。这一原则在同一职业内部同样适用——能以平庸的技能开幼龙级和暴风级很不错，但你一次只能开一艘。多样性是生活的调味品，能玩游戏的多个方面会有趣得多，但要知道，加入非教学型军团时，对方很可能希望你有某种“专精”，无论是电子战、驾驶特定舰船输出、后勤、采矿还是制造。

blocks.en: Another aspect of specialization is training all of the skills to use a ship effectively and to high levels. Let's take the Drake for example. The minimum requirements to fly one and shoot missiles out of it is Caldari Cruiser III, Caldari Battlecruiser I, Missile Launcher Operation III and Heavy Missiles I. However, if you train only these skills and try to fly a Drake, it will perform abysmally. Many extra skills are required to fly a ship effectively, such as fitting and capacitor skills, tanking skills, weapon skills, drone skills, and the specific ship skill (in this case Caldari Battlecruiser). Even with all of these trained to level III, you will still frequently be beaten in PvP by a pilot who has properly specialized in the ship and trained these skills to IV or V, and trained for Tech 2 modules and weapons.
blocks.zh: 专精的另一个方面是把有效使用某艘船所需的全部技能都练到高等级。以幼龙级为例。能驾驶它并用它发射导弹的最低要求是加达里巡洋舰操作 III、加达里战列巡洋舰操作 I、导弹发射器操作 III和重型导弹概论 I。然而，如果你只练了这些技能就去开幼龙级，它的表现会糟糕透顶。要有效驾驶一艘船还需要许多额外技能，例如装配和电容技能、坦克技能、武器技能、无人机技能，以及该舰船的专属技能（本例中是加达里战列巡洋舰操作）。即使把这些全部练到 III 级，在 PvP 中你仍然会经常被那些真正专精这艘船、把这些技能练到 IV 或 V 级、并练好了 T2 装备和武器的飞行员击败。

blocks.en: Ways to plan
blocks.zh: 规划方式

blocks.en: Here are three ways to organize your skill training around a particular focus or goal. These are certainly not the only ways to plan skill training - they are offered here only as examples.
blocks.zh: 以下是围绕特定重点或目标来安排技能训练的三种方式。它们当然不是规划技能训练的唯一方式，这里只是作为示例。

en: Training in short spurts designed to get the prerequisites to use a particular ship or module. These spurts are unlikely to ever be much more than a few weeks or a month long.

This method gives you the regular gratification of being able to use shinier stuff, but is probably an inefficient way to use your attributes and may miss important support skills that would make your ships and modules much more powerful.

Training in several-month-long stints designed to allow you to fly a particular ship or class of ships at peak or near peak performance, with all the relevant skills at IV or V. Several such stints can be combined to make a skill plan that lasts a year or more.
This method will make you a more reliable pilot but requires more patience and dedication, and research to find out which support skills you need.
Training in blocks each lasting a year or more, organized around the year-long time limit on neural remaps, and designed to eventually create a highly-skilled character.

So you might remap to boost Intelligence and Memory, then only train skills that rely on those two attributes for a year or more, before remapping to Perception and Willpower and focusing on skills that require those two attributes for another year.

This method uses your attributes very efficiently, resulting in an overall shorter training time. But it's also very boring since your character will probably be quite useless, with big holes in their skillsheet, for a year or more.
zh: 以短期冲刺的方式训练，目标是满足使用某艘船或某个装备的前置要求。这种冲刺一般不会超过几周或一个月。
这种方式能让你经常获得用上更好装备的满足感，但对属性的利用可能效率不高，而且可能会漏掉一些能让你的舰船和装备强大得多的重要辅助技能。
以持续数月的阶段进行训练，目标是让你能以巅峰或接近巅峰的水平驾驶某艘船或某类舰船，所有相关技能都达到 IV 或 V 级。可以把几个这样的阶段组合起来，形成一份持续一年或更久的技能计划。
这种方式能让你成为更可靠的飞行员，但需要更多耐心和投入，还要做功课弄清楚需要哪些辅助技能。
以每块持续一年或更久的大块方式训练，围绕神经重塑一年一次的时间限制来安排，最终目标是打造一个技能高超的角色。
比如你可以重塑提升智力和记忆，然后一年或更久只练依赖这两项属性的技能，再重塑到感知和毅力，在接下来的一年专注于需要这两项属性的技能。
这种方式对属性的利用非常高效，总体训练时间更短。但它也非常无聊，因为在一年或更长时间里，你的角色技能表上会有大片空白，很可能相当没用。

blocks.en: The first method is good for new players since it offers the interest of regularly being able to use new equipment. Avoiding long-term planning when you are new can actually be a good thing, since you may change your mind about your long-term career goals in EVE. Deciding that actually you want to be a small ship, Gallente-flying manufacturer, and explorer just after you have remapped for a two-year long Amarr-focused battleship fleet PvP skillplan is very inconvenient!
blocks.zh: 第一种方式适合新玩家，因为它能让你经常用上新装备，保持兴趣。刚入坑时避免长期规划其实可能是件好事，因为你可能会改变在 EVE 中的长期职业目标。刚为一份两年期、以艾玛战列舰舰队 PvP 为核心的技能计划做完重塑，就发现自己其实想当一个开盖伦特小船的制造商兼探索者，那可就太麻烦了！

blocks.en: The second and third methods are more useful for older players who have a clear and fixed idea of what they want to do. The third method in particular is very boring and is best suited to alts which are being skilled for a specific purpose (such as piloting supercapital ships) or to older characters who already have a good grounding in support skills and skills that let you do entertaining things while you chew through a list of month-long level V trains.
blocks.zh: 第二和第三种方式更适合目标清晰且确定的老玩家。尤其是第三种方式非常无聊，最适合为特定目的（例如驾驶超级旗舰）培养的小号，或者已经打好辅助技能基础、并且拥有能做有趣事情的技能的老角色，让他们在啃一长串动辄一个月的 V 级技能时也有事可做。
